// This is a test fixture. The .go.txt extension keeps Go's toolchain from
// trying to compile it. The deep-registry guard test copies it into a
// temporary repo as `internal/example/registered.go`.
package example

// FailureCode is registered in docs/error-codes.md and must pass the guard.
const FailureCode = "INTERNAL_ERROR"

// CapabilityName matches the SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE shape but is allowlisted
// in tools/lint/non_failure_code_literals.txt.
const CapabilityName = "DAC_OVERRIDE"

// AnnotatedLiteral demonstrates the per-line annotation. // not-a-failure-code
const AnnotatedLiteral = "WORKER_FOO_RESULT"

// PrecedingAnnotation demonstrates the annotation on the preceding line.
// not-a-failure-code
const PrecedingAnnotation = "WORKER_BAR_RESULT"
